gigapan.description: This specimen is from Antarctica and is the largest purely terrestrial animal on the continent, as well as its only true insect.  This is the larvae of the species and it was given to us to image by Molly Steinwald, a PhD candidate in the Department of Zoology in Miami. It has been magnified 500x using the Scanning Electron Microscope.
